quotes.text: D208446 requested a direct import instead of a dynamic module import in the AutoTreeView test fixture. The accepted fixture uses a static side-effect import for auto-tree-view.mjs, with a one-line import/no-unassigned-import exception. The class-export modules in this stack use PascalCase filenames such as TreeDataAdapter.mjs, TreeSelection.mjs, and AddrBookDataAdapter.mjs, while widget registration modules such as auto-tree-view.mjs keep kebab case. These are local naming patterns, not proof of a project-wide rule.
